program.name: Chest Volume
program.subject: Chest
program.blurb: Three chest days: heavy presses, press-and-fly supersets, then chest with the shoulders.
program.about: Chest from every angle across three days. The heavy day is straight sets of presses with long rests, the second pairs presses with flies and push-ups in supersets, and the third brings in the front shoulders. Triceps help throughout, as they do in every press. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Heavy press / press supersets / chest & shoulders
